title: Rav Aharon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in halakhic discussions in [Bava Kamma 109b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.109b.4) and [Menachot 74b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.74b.2): Ravina asked a question, and Rav Aharon said to Ravina, “Come and hear.”[^1]

notes.text: [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=259&lang=en) also pairs the two rulings, in both of which Rav Aharon answers Ravina.
